items.title: Levi45 Emulator (IPK)
items.author: Emil Nabil
items.desc: مشغل لاضافة حزمة أي بي كي
items.cmd:
set -e
URL='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/emilnabil/download-plugins/refs/heads/main/levi45emulator/enigma2-plugin-extensions-levi45emulator_all.ipk'
PKG='/tmp/levi45-emulator.ipk'
if command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then wget -O "$PKG" "$URL"; elif command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fL "$URL" -o "$PKG"; else echo 'wget or curl is not available'; exit 1; fi
if [ ! -s "$PKG" ]; then echo 'Installer file download failed'; exit 1; fi
if [ 'ipk' = 'ipk' ]; then
  if command -v opkg >/dev/null 2>&1; then opkg install "$PKG"; else echo 'This image has no opkg; IPK files are not supported here'; exit 1; fi
else
  if command -v dpkg >/dev/null 2>&1; then dpkg -i "$PKG"; else echo 'This image has no dpkg; DEB files are not supported here'; exit 1; fi
fi
rm -f "$PKG"
echo 'Install command finished; check the device log to confirm the package installed.'
